title: Foo fighters and Swedish ghost rockets
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Foo fighters and Swedish ghost rockets, about 1942-1946 at Europe; Sweden, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Foo fighters interfering with Allied fighter flight paths

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of the "foo fighters," the nickname for glowing balls that pilots reported during the Second World War, from about 1942 to 1945. He says Allied and German-side fighter pilots alike saw what looked like ball lightning that moved as if it were being controlled, and the story is grouped with the "ghost rockets" reported over Sweden just after the war. Michels places them differently in different episodes, once over Europe in general, once over Germany, and once specifically in Bavaria in southern Germany, and he tells it as an early sign that something was flying around that no side understood.
